title: А — Угловая клетка
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE pixel GAME BOSS sprite, full body, square 1:1 image, genuine transparent background. Image 1 shows actual Goat Out game sprites and defines chunky low-resolution art, overhead camera and dark muted palette. Image 2 is a PREVIOUS automaton, use ONLY its height and widely separated FOUR long metal legs. Redesign body exactly as follows. BODY IS A SQUARE IRON SKELETAL CAGE. A very clearly visible SQUARE TOP PERIMETER FRAME made of four straight welded iron rails, FOUR BARE IRON CORNER POSTS and a lower square iron frame. EVERY edge, corner, top rim and structural beam must remain PURE BARE METAL, uninterrupted and unobscured. Metal frame is in front of and outside the organic content. There is NO giant solid sheet-metal roof covering the entire square. The open top perimeter surrounds a recessed DARK IRON central cover well BELOW the rim; top must read as an actual welded square FRAME, not a flat plate, round shell, barrel or organic creature's shoulders. LIVING FLESH is contained INSIDE the cage, and bulges HORIZONTALLY OUT OF the broad SIDE OPENINGS BETWEEN the corner posts, below the upper frame and above the lower frame. Two or three broad convex burgundy muscle lobes per visible side push out like living mass too large for cage. The flesh stays at MID-HEIGHT of SIDE WALLS, NEVER on top, NEVER draped over any edge, NEVER at the corners or on the beams, NEVER on legs. Cleanly exposed iron top and corner silhouette, flesh protrudes from the middle of side apertures. Body is small, upper central 35% of silhouette width. Exactly FOUR separately countable long narrow iron legs with articulated knees, each attaches at one corner; very widely spaced footpads, big gaps between legs, open space under body a goat can run through. Legs 65-70% of total height, slender welded girders and simple piston, reddish brown mechanical knee couplings with pale shear pins. No organic limbs, arms, head, eyes, fifth leg, decorative steampunk gears, gold. Top-down three-quarter game view: see top square FRAME and two sides, far legs darker, front legs lighter, all four feet visible. Coarse actual sprite designed on ~144x144 logical pixel grid, enlarge by nearest-neighbor, thick crisp square pixel clusters, ONE logical pixel outline, three flat tones per material, limited 18-color muted palette. Dark grey blue steel, dull pale metal edges, sparse dark oxide red patches; dark wine-red muscle with muted dusty pink highlights, no gore spray. No microtexture, rivet noise, soft shading, gradients, shadows, glow, floor, text, labels or scenery. Complete silhouette with generous transparent margins, centered square composition. VARIANT D: simplest square welded cage with HEAVY L-SECTION corner posts and medium-width square top rails, visible pale weld stitches joining the four rails. Top perimeter is open and readable as four sides, recessed center contains plain dark iron panel. Each visible side has ONE large rectangular opening from which a broad smooth lump of meat bulges outward at center, skin folds stay wholly between posts. No chimney. Four long legs like original, square feet. Very clear game silhouette.
